verdict.rationale: Conductor's cloud workspaces persist and 'keep working after you close your laptop,' and a shareable link 'opens the workspace in Conductor for any member of the organization,' implying a task can be resumed elsewhere; the API/MCP also allow programmatic access to cloud workspaces from another client. However, Conductor is described as a native Mac app, and there's no evidence of a browser-based continuation path, and no explicit single-user cross-device resume flow is documented (the link evidence is framed around team collaboration, not personal multi-device use). Missing for 10: browser access/continuation, explicit same-user multi-device resume documentation, and independent confirmation of this workflow.
